Azuma Kamimura is one of the two heroines that have to be chosen from in Carla The Blood Lord to decide the route.

She is an Onmyoji specialized as a Vampire Hunter and the older sister of the Taimanin Kamimura Maika. She is also a friend and ally of the Vampire, Carla Cromwell.

Come on! What's the matter? I'm going to end up killing you all in no time, if you're all so slow! Give it your all, you vampiric bastards!
Kamimura Azuma


Personality
She has a rough and tomboyish personality with a dirty mouth. Normally easy to talk to, she drinks, smokes, and can come across as a bit of a scoundrel, but she deeply cares about her students, and when the students are in danger, she goes in headfirst. She is willing to risk her own life for others but often without a plan in mind. Often struggles with people who strictly follow the rules.

Azuma loves to drink, eat, and smoke, she does lack some self-control, as she rather just likes to live and jokes she could never save up as much money as the Queen of Vampires, Carla, could. She tends to fight with Marika Krishna every time the two meet, getting out their weapons almost every encounter, which is played off as a joke most of the time, as they will help each other most of the time if things get serious.

Appearance
She has violet eyes and orange/red hair.

History
Kamimura Azuma 3
Background
Born of the Taimanin family "Kamimura family", which are known to be good vampire hunters since ancient times.

However, Azuma herself never developed Taimanin abilities, instead gaining access to spiritual energy. It is stated that the lifestyle, way of fighting, and training of Taimanin did not appeal to Azuma, so she ran away from her home and clan and instead joined other groups that fought demons, like the Onmyoji Vampire Hunter.

Azuma, depending on continuity, became a Physical Education teacher, either at Hayato Private Academy or Gokou Academy. Regardless of her teaching occupation and love for her students, she often regardless goes on dangerous missions as she prefers field work. She is a close friend and rival of Marika Krishna, the Hell Knight of Carla Cromwell.

Visual Novels
Azuma was hired as a Vampire Hunter at Hayato Private Academy.

She worked for Uehara Kitae, the strongest barrier master, which could keep the academy safe from outside attacks. She had become a friend of Carla Cromwell, Kitae being an old friend of Carla. Furthermore, she would often fight with the servant of Carla, Marika Krishna, but this never went beyond mock battles.

She is known as Japan's strongest human vampire hunter and, at the Academy, acts as a teacher. She helped Carla with her uncle Gram, which put her on his target list later on, thinking she had killed him originally.

Depending on the route, she can be ignored, but this will lead to a trap for her later on. She will be killed, and her decapitated head shows up at the Hayato Private Academy after the other women have been enslaved. Alternatively, she will be infected by Gram's bug, which slowly mind breaks her into his loyal slave, deleting her memories of sexual encounters. Azuma also takes in some of Gram's blood, which she becomes addicted to. She later helps him with the capture of the other women, and all heroines end up as his loyal slave toys.

Timeline TABA
Azuma is again a teacher at Hayato Private Academy and guards Carla when she has talked with Igawa Asagi about Edwin Black.

During this event, she teamed up shortly with Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) against Yukina Grace of the UFS, which viewed both Carla and Kotaro as a potential target to be killed. After they forced Yukina to flee, Kotaro changed his target and was able to take Carla and escape with her. Azuma, Kitae, and Maika promise to free her later on.

Her younger sister, Kamimura Maika of the Kamimura clan, is also introduced, which means that Azuma either acts as a Rogue Taimanin or never becomes one. Meaning, she never awoke to Ninja Art or control of Taima Particles. However, she can still use other spiritual energies to fight regardless. Her sister shares many of her traits but hides her more cute side from her under her tough act.

Timeline RPGX
Azuma works as a teacher for Gokou Academy her spiritual power is explained as being an Onmyoji.

She is stated to be an Onmyoji specialist as a Vampire Hunter and tends to move around frequently. Like in Carla The Blood Lord, she is a Physical education teacher, but it isn't clear if she also teaches at Hayato Private Academy. She is sent out by Kibino Sanki to investigate the disappearance of Kiichi Azusa, a friend of hers. Azuma knows some Taimanin, including Akiyama Rinko, which may hint that she is more connected to her sister Kamimura Maika in that timeline.

She encountered Aishu Hebiko and Uehara Shikanosuke during an observation mission on Halloween, who was sent out dressed as a vampire to look for vampires. Helped to stop the "Halloween Darkness" a giant robot of Lune, taken over by the Evil Spirit of Halloween by mistake. Azuma later purified the spirit but stated it would return.

Powers/Abilities
Kamimura Azuma Ultimate
Main Weapon: Metal Bat, "Onikiri" or "Super Onikiri"

Keen Spiritual Sense: Can detect abnormalities, demonic or otherwise.
Weapon Expert: Her weapon has killed thousands of vampires and is charged with rune magic. Her weapon, Onikiri, can change form in RPGX, thanks to the help of future technology and magic.
Enhanced Strength: Her pure physical strength is superhuman, and it is said to rival Yatsu Murasaki.
Spiritual Control: She can charge her body and weapons with spiritual energy. Like Taima Particles, spiritual energy works well against demons.

alternate_greetings:
Carla: "You are just exaggerating now, aren't you?"
Azuma: "That's amazing... So, the reason why no man courts you is surely because you drink so much."
Marika: "Nh!? Ahem! Ahem! Ahem!"

Carla: "Oh! If I did want to suck on blood, then I would rather prefer a beautiful woman like you."
Azuma: "Geh!? You aren't coming onto me, are you!?"
Carla: "I was just joking. Marika is the kind of beautiful woman more suited to my tastes anyway."

Marika: "Fights should be swift."
Azuma: "Fights should be fun!"
Carla: "Fufu... I think both your contrasting opinions have some merit."
